name: v0.4.6
body:
## What's Changed
* (fix) browser sizing by @zonblade in https://github.com/aula-id/koma/pull/235
* (fix) browser popup & CF by @zonblade in https://github.com/aula-id/koma/pull/236
* fix panic on webkit, add nice installer by @zonblade in https://github.com/aula-id/koma/pull/237
* Enhance/features by @zonblade in https://github.com/aula-id/koma/pull/238
* Call SetWindowRgn from GDI and treat a missing region as null. by @zonblade in https://github.com/aula-id/koma/pull/239
* Enhance/features by @zonblade in https://github.com/aula-id/koma/pull/240
* Honor Windows local app data and connect terminal through named pipes by @zonblade in https://github.com/aula-id/koma/pull/241
* add partner provider and SDK by @zonblade in https://github.com/aula-id/koma/pull/243
* Keep the Linux GUI frame filled and fix the Open SDK checks. by @zonblade in https://github.com/aula-id/koma/pull/244
* Feature/new docs by @zonblade in https://github.com/aula-id/koma/pull/245
* Revert the direct push of the docs toml override by @zonblade in https://github.com/aula-id/koma/pull/246
* Pin toml to 5.0.1 in the docs site by @zonblade in https://github.com/aula-id/koma/pull/247
* Serve the docs site from /docs by @zonblade in https://github.com/aula-id/koma/pull/248
* Bound the terminal client so a streaming fence cannot retain every parse by @zonblade in https://github.com/aula-id/koma/pull/250
* Bring draw.io controls, shapes, tables, and groups to the diagram canvas by @zonblade in https://github.com/aula-id/koma/pull/253
* Make the designer canvas feel like Penpot: instances, smoothness, hover, text, clipboard by @zonblade in https://github.com/aula-id/koma/pull/252
* Rotate and resize designer shapes in their own frame by @zonblade in https://github.com/aula-id/koma/pull/251
* fix(windows): compare coding config path with the canonical workspace root by @arifintahu in https://github.com/aula-id/koma/pull/257
* Guard linker scans and show service memory by @zonblade in https://github.com/aula-id/koma/pull/258
* Install GUI libraries on Fedora and Arch, and check both in CI by @zonblade in https://github.com/aula-id/koma/pull/261
* Let a successful inspection clear stale recovery failures by @zonblade in https://github.com/aula-id/koma/pull/262
* Choose the Linux GUI window mode at install time by @zonblade in https://github.com/aula-id/koma/pull/265
* Show a signed-in Koma account's own models in the model picker by @zonblade in https://github.com/aula-id/koma/pull/266
* Chore/readme by @zonblade in https://github.com/aula-id/koma/pull/268
* Translate product README by @zonblade in https://github.com/aula-id/koma/pull/269
* Fall back to a 1M context window when the model is unknown or uncertain by @zonblade in https://github.com/aula-id/koma/pull/271

## New Contributors
* @arifintahu made their first contribution in https://github.com/aula-id/koma/pull/257

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/aula-id/koma/compare/v0.4.5...v0.4.6
